- [ ] FlyWire/root IDs are not parsed through float conversion.
- [ ] The living research log, experiment registry, results ledger, and claims register are updated when this changes scientific interpretation.
- [ ] Claims are hedged correctly. No broad AN claim is made unless supported by the actual validation.
